title: createSubscription ignores req.secret — webhook signing never activated via .secret field
symptom: TC-EXT-02-INT-05: signed_receiver.signature_seen = false after passing .secret = value to createSubscription
root_cause: CreateSubscriptionRequest.secret field is accepted but not persisted to secret_ref column. The INSERT stores req.secret_ref (NULL -> empty string) but ignores req.secret. webhook_dispatcher only signs when secret_ref.len > 0.
acceptance_criteria: createSubscription converts req.secret to a secret_ref value and stores it
notes: Pre-existing bug hidden by C42703 (column secret_ref does not exist) before ISS-0635 migration 1138 added the column.
resolution: src/webhook/subscription_store.zig: createSubscription now converts a non-null req.secret into a real secret_ref/secret_key_id pair via secrets.Store.putSecret (through the existing webhook_keys.WebhookKeyOwner.putWebhookHmacSecret helper, same convention already used by src/api/routes/webhooks.zig's HTTP route layer), BEFORE acquiring the connection used for the INSERT (putSecret acquires its own connection internally; nesting a second pool.acquire() inside an already-held lease would exhaust the pool, per GH-521/ISS-0130). validateCreateRequest now also rejects req.secret and req.secret_ref both being non-null (mirrors the HTTP layer's existing secret_conflict check). src/api/routes/webhooks.zig's handleCreateSubscription is unchanged — it already pre-converts and passes secret=null, so the new in-store conversion is a no-op on that path. Design: src/design/fix-ISS-0636.md.
